BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   B. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   B. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   C. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Money and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Business Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
